# Perth’s leading luxury real estate agencies and prestige auctioneers

As of October 2026, Perth has a strong group of specialist agencies serving the prestige residential market, particularly in Dalkeith, Peppermint Grove, Mosman Park, Cottesloe, City Beach, Claremont and the riverside suburbs.

**The key distinction is that the best-known luxury agencies are not necessarily the best auction operators.** Perth’s prestige market traditionally favours private treaty sales and negotiated, sometimes off-market, campaigns over auctions. Herron Todd White’s March 2026 review specifically identifies private treaty as the dominant approach in this segment. [htw.com.au](https://htw.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/HTW-Month-in-Review-Mar-2026-Resi.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[htw.com.au](https://htw.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/HTW-Prestige-Property-Monitor-Feb-2026.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Here is a practical shortlist, separating luxury positioning, evidence of sales performance and auction expertise.

## 1\. Leading luxury and prestige agencies

![Perth’s most famous socialite puts mansion on the market](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Uo3hfYJ3BiCKfMchBqzpwEQB9WdzPLu0HLHUef2OtYjzmJo9-8ENSBAynU8HdRWYW_Rl6qxYm9KPf7pORH5azWGYs8rcfyKdQ_La2I63damrYPZl_u4kHVWPfqz13BuIfLggFuqEBJhsn0BLBVTFFK3c0yJ8Lpiy_4IbsGtR_73vBVm9Kn4SFm6MqWu0tU0J?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. William Porteous Properties International

(Prestige specialist)

**Best for\:** Trophy homes, riverfront estates, luxury developments and top-end western suburbs property.

William Porteous is a long-established name in Perth prestige real estate, with a background specialising in luxury properties and developments and a recognised auctioneering profile. In REIWA’s July 2026 medium-office value rankings, the agency placed sixth, recording \$44.89 million in sales across 15 listings. Area: Dalkeith, Nedlands, Peppermint Grove, Mosman Park and surrounding prestige suburbs.

---

![Vivien Yap • Ray White](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/msh4PlXvQIL9-3cBUjOjJflfLnk6DC3V0jlL4YpjmS9q_MFlzntYJZ5EDeTcF0SmKrtkBCg0PSxIcrFmiuC-GCB8MNH_S3Agc7PEB5uIjoaePH-J4EQ24IPa7H9QlUkSE-_lrtcE7aZMhCxPAYuHcJ63QBxY_U9xpYrqu17L0ty85fdL2UZqAHOZaWMIBlC5?purpose=fullsize)

## 2\. Ray White Dalkeith | Claremont | Fremantle

(Strongest verified auction evidence)

**Key agent\:** Vivien Yap\.

This is a particularly strong option for sellers wanting measurable sales performance alongside auction capability. REIWA’s 2025–26 awards list the office as the number-one team by auction listings sold and Vivien Yap & Co as the number-one team by value sold. The office also ranked third among medium offices by value sold in July 2026, at \$47.01 million. Area: Western suburbs, riverside homes and selected coastal prestige markets.

## 3\. Mack Hall Real Estate in association with Knight Frank

**Best for\:** High-value western suburbs residences, established estates and premium property advisory.

Mack Hall is worth shortlisting for properties where local prestige-market experience and tailored representation matter. Senior agent Peter Burns has a long association with the western suburbs market and a documented history in high-value sales. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Peter+Burns+at+Mack+Hall+Real+Estate/@-31.9812026,115.7814669,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x2a32a5d1a6215b49:0x5a7a64277e4c1ecd!8m2!3d-31.9812026!4d115.7814669!16s%2Fg%2F11ypfz8601?authuser=0&hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDQwOC4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[reiwa.com.au](https://reiwa.com.au/uploadedfiles/public/content/find_an_agent/sales_winners_pdf/top30repsvaluesoldaug2014.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Area: Claremont, Mosman Park and neighbouring western suburbs.

## 4\. Western Australia Sotheby's International Realty

**Best for\:** International exposure and premium brand positioning.

A contender for architect-designed homes, luxury apartments and properties likely to attract interstate or overseas buyers. Its international network can be useful where the marketing strategy needs to extend beyond Perth's local buyer pool. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Western+Australia+Sotheby's+International+Realty/@-31.9603744,115.868396,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x2a32bad5c6bfffff:0x276cbe975334cec7!8m2!3d-31.9603744!4d115.868396!16s%2Fg%2F11fk3w6582?hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDkyMy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Area: Perth metropolitan market and wider Western Australia.

Property developer Colin Langer’s former City Beach abode a textbook example of modern luxury | PerthNow](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Vl0ow0Z8-2I-SN_aXvG06EHrZrXWn_buyM6vzrD9kGriT9DXmNsfV1RTuCpv00VtW-wHvFqbU2suopiMSc2UwEAGNoRNwqa_cZB6nVe4VMm-7zKtTVueyWE4rIvamZw0PK-UNI5CHt4w0yfytP1Dgs61JLCXFnczh-E0f7oQ3ohC1dBcmdPRZJHWy2tsdZtB?purpose=fullsize)

## 5\. Christie's International Real Estate Western Australia & South Australia

**Best for\:** Bespoke luxury marketing, privacy and international reach.

Another luxury-branded option to consider for distinctive residences and exceptional properties where presentation, buyer targeting and discreet handling are priorities. Compare its proposed campaign and relevant local settled sales with those of established Perth specialists. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJ73seN2OlMioRguH1Df-7tK4&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Area: Perth-based, with broader WA and SA coverage.

![Property 144287468, Cottesloe, WA 6011 - Property Details](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/mPGsC_G29C-aObK5ZBK84ibWiwOyohkEE_a8XvKzntEZyAvvjvYpvvGNmGFbTNxm_t73dLvVSR1BF1p8BGC_2190WTIlImdW3A6cEyHZqHh8jSerbmIOfSrQg7KU9NMe8r988Q9STCc_dctOCpe4LZJkAKpnEEIHOP3WlFYkUg8PjsjnnqD2lyA8mSd7PKh9?purpose=fullsize)

## 6\. Space Real Estate

**Best for\:** Coastal prestige homes and architecturally distinctive residences.

A useful independent agency to compare for Cottesloe, City Beach and western suburbs properties. Its coastal focus may be particularly relevant for homes whose lifestyle appeal is as important as their price point. Area: Cottesloe, western suburbs and selected South West lifestyle markets.

Other agencies worth adding to a vendor interview list include Duet Property Group, which has a strong western-suburbs sales record, and ChoiceOne, which was associated with the \$15.3 million Dalkeith sale reported in June 2026. The latter is a useful reference point for the very top end of the market. [www.perthnow.com.au](https://www.perthnow.com.au/news/business/property/perths-top-real-estate-agents-jody-fewster-susan-james-and-john-hunter-reveal-what-makes-market-tick-c-19355504?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[opteonsolutions.com](https://opteonsolutions.com/au/insights/perths-prestige-property-market-riding-the-peak-as-the-cycle-turns?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 2\. Top-performing auctioneers and auction teams

For auction performance, the clearest publicly verifiable signal in the research is the recent REIWA and Ray White recognition of the Dalkeith–Claremont office. Individual auctioneering ability, however, should be assessed separately from an agency's number of auction listings.

![Vivien Yap • Ray White](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/L03LK_ut5uZ910oXBB755x7ffl8KNf2yg7Lkkh35fk2PZqdyaP3lr-IpIV9XOrZTnDjh7wOjCJF2Nar2-GjT1BWuzUqLxOSnCtmDUylVCqcVthhmWxr0HBB7G7qA7Kga2xtdnX1ruaDVytxS2jJ3BMQf5_ssmIkXwbBPNsMGg991ohQjONSD3mbV_ARilxUK?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Vivien Yap — Ray White Dalkeith | Claremont**

The strongest documented starting point for auction-led residential campaigns. Her team held the number-one REIWA position for auction listings sold in 2025–26, alongside the number-one team ranking by value sold. A notable candidate when you want a senior prestige-property specialist who is also known as an auctioneer. His experience is especially relevant to luxury homes and high-value developments. Public business information identifies his auctioneering role, although I could not verify a current independent ranking placing him among Perth's top auctioneers. **4\. Ian Barnes — Majestic Central Agents**

An auction-focused sales consultant based in Applecross. He is another candidate to consider if you want a dedicated auction-oriented campaign, but comparable prestige-auction results and recent sale values should be requested before ranking him alongside the leaders above. Best fit: A tailored auction campaign, subject to relevant comparable sales.

## 3\. What the latest performance figures show

The most useful way to separate reputation from measurable results is to examine REIWA's published sales and auction rankings.

| Performance indicator | Leading result | Period |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Residential team by value sold | Vivien Yap & Co — \$316.96m | 2025–26 |
| Auction listings sold by office | Ray White Dalkeith | Claremont — \#1 in August | August 2026 |
| Medium office by value sold | Ray White Dalkeith | Claremont — \$95.76m | August 2026 |
| Medium office by value sold | William Porteous Properties International — \$44.89m | July 2026 |


Sources: REIWA's [annual team rankings](https://reiwa.com.au/agent-finder/reiwa-com-awards/award-details/?award=1005&period=8257), [auction results](https://reiwa.com.au/agent-finder/reiwa-com-awards/award-details/?award=1014&period=8381) and [office sales rankings](https://reiwa.com.au/agent-finder/reiwa-com-awards/award-details/?award=1084&period=8370)\. [reiwa.com.au](https://reiwa.com.au/agent-finder/reiwa-com-awards/award-details/?award=1005&period=8257&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[reiwa.com.au](https://reiwa.com.au/agent-finder/reiwa-com-awards/award-details/?award=1014&period=8381&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[reiwa.com.au](https://reiwa.com.au/agent-finder/reiwa-com-awards/award-details/?award=1084&period=8370&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

These figures are useful, but they are not a definitive ranking of luxury-home performance: agency totals can include properties well below the prestige price bracket, and an office selling the most auction listings is not necessarily the one achieving the highest auction premium.

## 4\. My recommendation by property type

**For an auction-led campaign**

Start with Ray White Dalkeith | Claremont and Vivien Yap & Co. Their recent auction and sales rankings provide the strongest directly verifiable performance evidence in this shortlist.

---

**For a trophy home or multimillion-dollar estate**

Interview William Porteous Properties International and Mack Hall. Ask each to demonstrate recent comparable sales in the same price bracket, rather than relying on broad agency turnover.

---

**For an internationally marketed luxury property**

Compare Sotheby's International Realty and Christie's International Real Estate on their actual overseas buyer reach, campaign strategy and relevant settled sales.

---

**For a coastal or architect-designed home**

Include Space Real Estate and the relevant local prestige team in your comparison. Architectural understanding and the quality of the targeted buyer database can matter more than agency size.

Before appointing an auctioneer, ask for three comparable sales, the number of registered bidders at recent similar auctions, the proportion of auctions sold under the hammer, the proportion sold after auction, and the net result after marketing and commission. These figures are more informative than awards alone.

**One important caveat\:** I could verify office-level auction awards and individual agents' auction credentials, but not a comprehensive, independently audited league table of Perth auctioneers ranked by clearance rate or premium achieved specifically for prestige homes.

search_results.title: Villa Alcyone: Award-winning Elanora mansion eyes suburb record
search_results.description: Villa Alcyone, a Mediterranean-style mansion situated on a steep 890 sqm block at 6 Bicton Ct in Elanora, has entered the market with expectations to surpass the suburb's sales record by millions. Designed by Jayson Pate and built by Resolve Constructions, the award-winning home reflects a growing trend of luxury builders tackling challenging vertical sites. The property garnered multiple accolades at the 2026 HIA Gold Coast and Northern Rivers Awards and a Master Builders Queensland award. The four-bedroom, four-bathroom home spans 579 sqm and features high-end finishes such as Italian marble, dramatic archways, and a Sukabumi stone pool, all inspired by European influences during the owners' travels. Interior design was led by co-owner Helen Foukkare. Positioned to maximize ocean views and offering access to popular nearby beaches like Currumbin and Palm Beach, the mansion is drawing interest from high-end buyers typically focused on more traditionally prestigious areas. Although quarterly data shows a slight dip in Elanora home prices, the suburb's annual values rose 14.7 percent, reflecting its evolving luxury market appeal. The Foukkares are already planning another unique luxury build in the Gold Coast region.

# Perth’s leading luxury real estate agencies and prestige auctioneers

As of October 2026, Perth has a strong group of specialist agencies serving the prestige residential market, particularly in Dalkeith, Peppermint Grove, Mosman Park, Cottesloe, City Beach, Claremont and the riverside suburbs.

**The key distinction is that the best-known luxury agencies are not necessarily the best auction operators.** Perth’s prestige market traditionally favours private treaty sales and negotiated, sometimes off-market, campaigns over auctions. Herron Todd White’s March 2026 review specifically identifies private treaty as the dominant approach in this segment. [htw.com.au](https://htw.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/HTW-Month-in-Review-Mar-2026-Resi.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[htw.com.au](https://htw.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/HTW-Prestige-Property-Monitor-Feb-2026.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Here is a practical shortlist, separating luxury positioning, evidence of sales performance and auction expertise.

## 1\. Leading luxury and prestige agencies

## 1\. William Porteous Properties International

(Prestige specialist)

**Best for\:** Trophy homes, riverfront estates, luxury developments and top-end western suburbs property.

William Porteous is a long-established name in Perth prestige real estate, with a background specialising in luxury properties and developments and a recognised auctioneering profile. In REIWA’s July 2026 medium-office value rankings, the agency placed sixth, recording \$44.89 million in sales across 15 listings. ## 6\. Space Real Estate

**Best for\:** Coastal prestige homes and architecturally distinctive residences.

A useful independent agency to compare for Cottesloe, City Beach and western suburbs properties. Its coastal focus may be particularly relevant for homes whose lifestyle appeal is as important as their price point. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJxw12U7FsrwER7XfQC6leE8U&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.perthnow.com.au](https://www.perthnow.com.au/news/business/property/perths-top-real-estate-agents-jody-fewster-susan-james-and-john-hunter-reveal-what-makes-market-tick-c-19355504?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[opteonsolutions.com](https://opteonsolutions.com/au/insights/perths-prestige-property-market-riding-the-peak-as-the-cycle-turns?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Area: Cottesloe, western suburbs and selected South West lifestyle markets.

Other agencies worth adding to a vendor interview list include Duet Property Group, which has a strong western-suburbs sales record, and ChoiceOne, which was associated with the \$15.3 million Dalkeith sale reported in June 2026. The latter is a useful reference point for the very top end of the market. [www.perthnow.com.au](https://www.perthnow.com.au/news/business/property/perths-top-real-estate-agents-jody-fewster-susan-james-and-john-hunter-reveal-what-makes-market-tick-c-19355504?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[opteonsolutions.com](https://opteonsolutions.com/au/insights/perths-prestige-property-market-riding-the-peak-as-the-cycle-turns?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 2\. Top-performing auctioneers and auction teams

For auction performance, the clearest publicly verifiable signal in the research is the recent REIWA and Ray White recognition of the Dalkeith–Claremont office. Individual auctioneering ability, however, should be assessed separately from an agency's number of auction listings.

These figures are useful, but they are not a definitive ranking of luxury-home performance: agency totals can include properties well below the prestige price bracket, and an office selling the most auction listings is not necessarily the one achieving the highest auction premium.

## 4\. My recommendation by property type

**For an auction-led campaign**

Start with Ray White Dalkeith | Claremont and Vivien Yap & Co. Their recent auction and sales rankings provide the strongest directly verifiable performance evidence in this shortlist.

---

**For a trophy home or multimillion-dollar estate**

Interview William Porteous Properties International and Mack Hall. Ask each to demonstrate recent comparable sales in the same price bracket, rather than relying on broad agency turnover.

---

**For an internationally marketed luxury property**

Compare Sotheby's International Realty and Christie's International Real Estate on their actual overseas buyer reach, campaign strategy and relevant settled sales.

---

**For a coastal or architect-designed home**

Include Space Real Estate and the relevant local prestige team in your comparison. Architectural understanding and the quality of the targeted buyer database can matter more than agency size.

Before appointing an auctioneer, ask for three comparable sales, the number of registered bidders at recent similar auctions, the proportion of auctions sold under the hammer, the proportion sold after auction, and the net result after marketing and commission. These figures are more informative than awards alone.

**One important caveat\:** I could verify office-level auction awards and individual agents' auction credentials, but not a comprehensive, independently audited league table of Perth auctioneers ranked by clearance rate or premium achieved specifically for prestige homes.
